compression.payload_container: JSON strings split into at most 4060-character chunks

encoding.action: target edge (u,v) receives source bit at (perm[u],perm[v]); identical to permuteLocalMask in R44Cover6S7Transport
encoding.bitstream_endianness: little-endian 15-bit words concatenated least-significant bit first, then emitted as little-endian 6-bit URL-safe alphabet digits
encoding.selection_rule: least lexicographic permutation rank producing the full cube

implementation.common_mode_boundary: Catalogue generation, projection, and S7 action reuse the existing Python replay/bridge; this is not an independent derivation of them.
implementation.name: certify_cover6_conditioned_orbit_witnesses.py

lean_integration_boundary.honest_boundary: The JSON witnesses and Python verification do not by themselves enter Lean's trusted proof. A Lean decoder plus finite equality checks remain necessary before using these witnesses in the graph-level satisfaction proof.
sufficient_checks: at item i, read the 15 bits starting at bit offset 15*i and reject codes >= 30240
unrank the S7 permutation in lexicographic order
for K7, prove decoded source cube = permuteCube permutation representative
for K6, reconstruct the full cube, check root compatibility, and prove its projection equals the decoded source cube
feed the resulting CubeInOrbitOf witness to orbitCube_forces_motif

normalized_core_specific_ordered_view.ordering: core_clause_id order, exactly coreNormalizedFinIndices order; blocker indices are unchanged by Master8-to-core8 normalization
normalized_core_specific_ordered_view.reconstruction: derive subset/embedding and catalogue position from each normalized core index, then index the existing conditioned cube and witness streams

projected_k6_canonical_lift_orbit_witnes.full_lift_reconstruction: apply the decoded S7 permutation to the decoded representative

scope: Exact finite positional witnesses for the conditioned cube payloads; no SAT, LRAT, graph-to-CNF satisfaction theorem, or cover6-d8 theorem.
